feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that our inequality

$$
(x-1)(x+5)<0,
$$

is a "*less than*" inequality. Therefore, we need to find the values of $x$ for which the parabola

$$
y=(x-1)(x+5)
$$

 
is *below* the $x$-axis. We mark these values of $x$ in blue in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13972108/assets/910856b0bf27df0038488fadfdb7dee8a8bd259ffbadf3a1f8c6f44f3a39cb3f.png)

So, the solution to the inequality is $-5<x<1.$
